dsh-video-tools is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Browser-local audio/video toolkit for DSH — extract frames, capture thumbnails, compress images, and convert clips to GIF with FFmpeg.wasm.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-c94ddbf18248794b1d2c.html
